ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 1:3 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-contrast white patch occupying approximately 40% of the right lobe surface area with internal dark circular mottling; left lobe features sparse, high-intensity white stippling concentrated along the distal margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured internal angle of approximately 80 degrees; notch depth is roughly 25% of the visible vertical height of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible across the entirety of the trailing edge boundary; most pronounced irregularity located on the distal third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute tips with a slight posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along the lower right lobe boundary, characteristic of sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, dark linear disruption is visible at a roughly 45-degree angle cutting through the white pigmentation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of irregular tissue loss on the tip of the left lobe creating a jagged terminal profile; diagonal rake-like scar on the right lobe white patch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique internal 'leopard' mottling pattern of dark spots within the white pigmentation of the right lobe.
